name: Family Residency (dependent sponsorship)

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsor's monthly income must reach QAR 10,000/month (government/semi-government sector, or with employer-provided housing); a lower QAR 6,000/month threshold applies to private-sector technical/specialized roles with employer-provided housing.
Mandatory health insurance for all sponsored dependents (previously required only for dependents aged 60+; MOI clarification dated 19 Jan 2024).
requirements.fix_path: Obtain qualifying health insurance for each dependent.

sources.title: Fragomen (immigration law firm) -- Qatar revised family residency and visit visa requirements: QAR 10,000/6,000/month sponsor-income thresholds by sector, mandatory health insurance for all dependents effective 19 Jan 2024 per MOI clarification

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Qatar). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced only to a tier-3 immigration law firm; MOI's own family-sponsorship rules page (tier-1) was unreachable in this build (robots.txt-blocked).
